While memory costs are projected to easily be the most expensive component of the iPhone 18 Pro's bill of materials, the same may not be true for the iPhone Duo. Here are the details.

Apple Signs Three-Year Exclusive Display Deal With Samsung Display

Leaker Instant Digital said on Weibo today that Apple and Samsung Display have signed a three-year exclusive supply agreement for foldable panels.

According to the leaker, Samsung Display will be the exclusive supplier of foldable panels for the iPhone Duo "and subsequent models," with each panel costing approximately $250.

The leaker also noted that the panel "is one of the most expensive core components in the entire device," which isn't exactly surprising.

While there aren't yet reliable reports on the expected bill of materials for the iPhone Duo, by breaking down the costs of the display, camera, processor, memory, and other components, Apple has shared some interesting information about the materials used in the device, including how much recycled material it contains.
